payload.purpose_context: The shared Spec Kitty mission screens need a workspace where Lit screen elements are built, previewed in Storybook against the design system, and checked by the charter's quality gates before any real screen is written.
payload.purpose_tldr: Stand up the mission-ui monorepo with Storybook and quality gates so screen work can start.

options: GITHUB_TOKEN with this repo granted Actions access on each package
Org secret holding a read:packages PAT
payload.question: How should CI authenticate to install the private @spec-kitty/* packages from GitHub Packages?

payload.final_answer: CI runs on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runners and installs @spec-kitty/* with a read:packages classic PAT stored as the repo secret NPM_TOKEN (same kind as QA_NPM_TOKEN). The repo .npmrc holds only the scope mapping; local builds use the developer's own ~/.npmrc token.

payload.wp_title: Credential preflight command, plants and harness tests
Storybook app wired to the design system, with build gate and plant
sk-mission-sample element, four stories and interaction tests
Typecheck, ESLint and Stylelint gates with plants
No-I/O and element manifest gates with plants
Hygiene gate: credentials, paths, pins, workflow rules
Visual regression gate with pinned container and baselines
GitHub Actions workflow with one named job per gate
Gate proof harness, record, local run
